neutral_facts.value: The accused, along with two other individuals, planned and executed a robbery at a pawn shop. During the robbery, one of the accused held the legs of the deceased, who was sleeping inside the shop, while another sat on his chest and strangled him to death with a rope. The accused robbed the shop of approximately 4.788 kg of gold and 5.595 kg of silver, totaling around Rs.12,00,000. The deceased's brother discovered the body and reported the incident to the police. The police registered a case under Sections 457, 380, and 302 of the IPC. The investigation led to the arrest of all accused, with confessions from some of them resulting in the recovery of stolen jewelry from various locations. The prosecution presented evidence including witness testimonies, the registers of the pawn shop, and recovered items to establish the involvement of the accused in the dacoity and murder.
